description: Defines the quic::QuicCryptoClientConfig class and related structures for managing QUIC client cryptographic configuration, including server state caching, handshake message processing, and session management.

classes.name: QuicResumptionState
classes.description: Stores state information for QUIC connection resumption, including TLS session, transport parameters, application state, and token.

classes.name: SessionCache
classes.description: Interface for storing and retrieving QuicResumptionState objects, managing session data for resumption.

classes.name: QuicCryptoClientConfig
classes.description: Manages cryptographic configuration for a QUIC client, including server state caching, handshake message processing, and session management.

classes.name: QuicCryptoClientConfig::CachedState
classes.description: Holds cached server configuration and proof data necessary for 0-RTT handshakes.

classes.name: QuicCryptoClientConfig::ServerIdFilter
classes.description: Interface for filtering server IDs for partial cache deletion.

methods.name: LookupOrCreate
methods.description: Returns a CachedState for a given server ID, creating it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: ClearCachedStates
methods.description: Removes cached states matching a filter.

methods.name: FillInchoateClientHello
methods.description: Creates a client hello message to elicit server configuration or tokens.

methods.name: FillClientHello
methods.description: Creates a client hello message based on cached configuration.

methods.name: ProcessRejection
methods.description: Processes a server rejection message and updates cached state.

methods.name: ProcessServerHello
methods.description: Processes a server hello message and updates cached state.

methods.name: ProcessServerConfigUpdate
methods.description: Processes server config update message and updates cached state.
